_note: Batch 14: the ARC family. This is the fixture gap that blocked composition_conformance_run back in batch 4 — an arc could not be seeded, so the tool refused correctly and looked like a miss. composition_arc_create writes immediately via MCP (no card), so the arc is seedable and the whole family becomes testable. Prompts use declared synonyms VERBATIM, per batch 13: a paraphrase tests DQ-T32 (the matcher), not the tool.

scenarios.prompt: Create arc — I want to author an arc called The Drowned Court for this book.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM structure_node WHERE book_id='{book_id}' AND kind='arc'
seed_assert.why: ZERO arcs before, so any arc is attributable to this turn — and, since the card is never approved, the count must still be 0 afterwards.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: an arc lands with NO confirm card (Tier A), OR the op chosen is not `create` when the user said create — its op enum spans create|edit|delete|archive|restore|move|reorder, and a destructive op on a create request would be the worst outcome. Store check: structure_node arc count stays 0.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A, and its op enum includes DELETE, so the gate matters more than usual.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — an op naming a node that does not exist must be refused.

scenarios.prompt: Read arc — show me the arc detail for The Hollow Keep.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM structure_node WHERE book_id='{book_id}' AND kind='arc' AND title LIKE '%Hollow Keep%'
seed_assert.why: THE ARC MUST EXIST — this is the fixture that batch 4 could not build, which is why composition_conformance_run refused correctly and was scored as a miss. The tool takes a node_id, so the model must resolve the arc's NAME to it.

answer_expect.why: The seeded arc is the only one; naming it is the minimum evidence that the arc was actually read rather than described.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a read-intent turn changes the store, OR the model invents a node_id rather than resolving 'The Hollow Keep' (the D-DECLARED-UUID class, now guarded — a fabricated-but-valid UUID here is a NEW instance), OR the reply describes arc content the seeded arc does not have (it has a title and nothing else, so any beats/tracks are fabricated).

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a node_id that does not exist must be refused, and must be distinguishable from an arc that exists but is empty (D-ABSENT-ENTITY-READS-AS-UNUSED).

scenarios.prompt: Save arc as template — turn The Hollow Keep into a reusable arc template.
scenarios.prompt_source: _meta.synonyms['save arc as template'] + ['make arc template'], verbatim.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM structure_node WHERE book_id='{book_id}' AND kind='arc'
seed_assert.why: One arc to extract from; the tool needs its node_id plus a code and a name it must derive from the request.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a template is created with NO confirm card, OR the model invents a node_id, OR it fabricates a `code` that collides with an existing template rather than deriving a fresh one. NOTE the account already holds arc templates (arc_template_list returns several), so a collision is reachable and its refusal is worth seeing.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — extracting from a node that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — a duplicate `code` must be refused, not silently overwrite an existing template.

scenarios.prompt: Apply arc template — use one of my library arc templates on this book.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM structure_node WHERE book_id='{book_id}' AND kind='arc'
seed_assert.why: ZERO arcs before, so an applied template is attributable — and, the card never being approved, the count must still be 0 afterwards.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: an arc is materialised with NO confirm card, OR the model invents an arc_template_id rather than listing the library first (composition_arc_template_list is the supplier). CONTROL: the account genuinely holds arc templates, so 'there are none' would contradict a known reading and is a finding either way.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A; applying a template materialises structure.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — an arc_template_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — book-scoped, and the template library is account-scoped: another account's template must not apply.

scenarios.prompt: Reverse-engineer arc — analyze a work I imported and deconstruct its structure.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: it spends LLM tokens with no confirm card (Tier W and it analyses a whole work), OR it proceeds with an invented import_source_id. CONTROL, stated up front: the fixture has NO import source, so the honest outcome is a refusal naming what is missing — and a turn that cannot proceed is a PRECONDITION finding, not a tool defect. If it mints a card over a nonexistent source that is D-EXTRACTION-CONFIRMS-A-NO-OP again, in a third tool of the same family.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier W and it spends.
ship_audit.absent_case: This scenario IS the absent case — there is no import source, so the refusal is the evidence.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — user-scoped; another account's import source must be refused.
